name: Peninsula Teen Advisory Council (PTAC)
what_you_do: Help plan library events for teens and share your ideas. Promote the library at school. Speak at library board meetings four times a year. Do at least 5 volunteer hours a school year.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 14 to 18 at a PVPUSD school or local private school, or who are home schooled. Up to 20 members.
duration: Meetings once a month, one Monday from 4:00 to 4:45 p.m. on Zoom
deadline_text: The library says openings are available as of Nov 3, 2026. No deadline is listed.
how_to_apply: Send the PTAC application and the library volunteer application. A parent or guardian signs both. Then you have an interview. Questions: ocatalan@pvld.org.
notes: If the group is full, you go on a waiting list. You can miss no more than 3 meetings without an excuse. You must also attend one PTAC event each semester.
